headlines.title: Tesla board member Joe Gebbia: Nvidia should “reinstate” Jensen Huang to let investigation play out
headlines.summary: Joe Gebbia, the U.S. chief design officer, Airbnb cofounder, and Tesla board member, told Alyson Shontell that Nvidia should reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and then run a due diligence process. “Nvidia is one of the greatest companies ever of all time, and it got there because of founder mode,” Gebbia said at the F500 Innovation Forum.

headlines.title: Airbnb bets big on multibillion-dollar hotel opportunity
headlines.summary: Hotels were once a “natural enemy” to Airbnb, CEO Brian Chesky said on a recent podcast. Now, they present a strategic chance to attract and retain customers and drive previously unthinkable revenue.

headlines.title: Airbnb: PhillipCapital upgrades stock as bookings accelerate
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- PhillipCapital upgraded Airbnb (NASDAQ: ABNB) to Neutral from Reduce and raised its price target to $184 from $158 in a note Monday, citing a sharp acceleration in third-quarter bookings.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
